subject: Reduce function - String input from List - Not working

messages.author: 7dead4dd4fc5438c
messages.subject: Reduce function - String input from List - Not working
parts:
I am trying to input a list of file names from Infile option into Reduce function for merging multiple table input. 

But the input from Infile is with quotes, but the need something like c(a,b,c) for reduce function to work.

I have attached the server.R code below...

library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input,output)
{
  output$data <-   renderUI({
      res <- lapply(1:input$fnos, function(i) {fileInput(paste("file",i),"Load File",accept =c('text/csv',
                                                                                               'text/comma-separated-values',
                                                                                               'text/tab-separated-values',
                                                                                               'text/plain','.csv','.tsv' ))})
   })
 
  output$multi <- renderTable({
        
    infile <- list(lapply(1:input$fnos, function(i) {input[[paste("file",i)]]}))[[1]]
    for (i in 1:length(infile)) {assign(infile[[c(i,1)]], read.csv((infile[[c(i,4)]])))}
    frames <- list(lapply(1:input$fnos, function(i) {infile[[c(i,1)]]}))[[1]]

    maxi <- list(lapply(1:input$fnos, function(i) {paste(frames[i])}))[[1]]
    print(maxi)
    merged <- Reduce(function(x,y) merge(x,y), list(paste(maxi,"",sep=","))) #not working
 }) 
})

Request to help on this issue..

-- Santhana
